name: Event
description: Creates Event Entities for managing Events.
project_description:
Event is a custom entity that allows you to store events on your drupal site. The module is under construction with the Conference Organizing Distribution

 Back to top 

 Versions

Version one of this module includes the event_group and gevent sub modules. These modules depended on version 1 of the Group Module. In order to provide support for newer versions of the Group Module, these projects have been split into their own projects as part of Event Version 2. They are available below.

Event Group - For managing group attendees using Groups.
Group Events - For managing ownership/access to Events using Group Membership.

Key features
Custom event entity with fields related to event management
Example views for sites to implement their own event
API for other modules to share a common data format for events
Installing
Composer is recommended for installing. Make sure when you require in or use composer update, you use --with-all-dependencies otherwise the machine_name core patch won't get applied. If you don't use composer, you must patch core yourself with the latest patch here: [#2685749] 
Contribute!
If you're a camp, event organizer, or site needing the use of events, this module is the one for you. If you're looking to build something, help by contributing back your work!
You can find us in #drupal-cod on Drupal slack
Older event module
The last release of this module was in Drupal 5 and is no longer supported. There is a D6 port that was started, but this has also been abandoned. If you're looking for support, you should contact Killes.
 There is no upgrade path from D5/D6 to the D8 version of event. 
Please take some time to look at the module's settings and read the documentation.
